description: Make a simple sales receipt as PDF: an 80 mm thermal-roll receipt (page height fits the content, monospace) or an A5 page. Shop header (name, address, phone, tax number), receipt number with prefix, date/time, customer, items (name × qty × price), discount (% or fixed amount), tax % after discount, total, payment method, amount paid and change, note and footer. Same maths as the website: amounts rounded half-up to 0, 2 or 3 decimals. Also returns the totals and a 32-column plain-text version. English labels, Latin text only for now. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/receipt-maker/

disc.description: Discount: a percentage, or an amount when discType is "amt".

discType.description: pct = percent of subtotal (default), amt = fixed amount.

format.description: thermal = 80 mm roll (default), a5 = A5 page.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

shop.description: Shop details: name, address, phone, taxId, currency, decimals, prefix, footer.

currency.description: Currency text written after amounts, e.g. JD, USD, $ (default JD).

tax.description: Tax rate % applied after the discount.

name: doc_receipt
title: Receipt PDF
